description:
**Req \#** 209208 **Location** Gurgaon, Haryana, India **Job Category** Sales **Date posted** 09/17/2026
  
**Overview**
------------


As a member of Baxter’s sales team, you’ll be aligned to one of our global business units and be responsible for new business, developing existing accounts and ensuring patient\-centric approach in all your dealings. You’ll work within an assigned geographic area or with specific accounts to achieve or exceed personal and business goals, all in pursuit of our mission to save and sustain lives. In the sales role, you’ll have the opportunity to provide input on new markets and products, manage customer concerns, and collaborate with other teams.


* Support for Parents

**Success Profile**
-------------------


What makes a successful Sales Professional at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit.


* Stakeholder Insight and Influence
* Sales Solution Identification and Development
* Negotiation Skills
* Strategic Planning
* Managing and Coaching
* Ownership of the Business

  
**This is where** your work makes a difference.


At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.


Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.


Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

**Your Role at Baxter**
-----------------------

**THIS IS WHERE you build trust to achieve results**


As a Sr. Asst Mgr, Sales, you will be responsible for driving primary sales through product promotion in defined territory by meeting HCPs and para medical staff, Coordinating with commercial or purchase authorities and channel partners for ensuring supply and liquidation of products. Drive awareness and adoption through activations in the territory/accounts.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

**Strategic Imperative:** Drive awareness and adoption on Anaesthetics amongst Anesthetists in the assigned territories.( Baxter is the only company to offer the most commonly used modern inhaled anesthetics for general anesthesia. This includes a proprietary inhaled anesthetic, SUPRANE (desflurane, USP), AERRANE (isoflurane, USP) and SEVOFLURANE (sevoflurane, USP).

**Planning:** Monthly account wise planning of secondary sales leading to primary sales for their territory/accounts. Weekly planning for coverage and calls. Monthly/quarterly sales forecast for defined territory. Quarterly activation planning.

**Execution:** Drives adherence to SFE processes :, Call average, customer coverage, working days, SME trackers, prescription tracker, secondary sales and product sampling/demonstrations. To track all product and service quality related complaints and coordinate with National/Sales Manager/quality to ensure formal response and closure to complaints report it to PV \& Quality. Competition \& Market Mapping \- Track and gather market data, no. of indicated surgeries, gather and analyze competitor activities. P5 Implementation – Implementation of Marketing strategy and activations as per defined GTM. Identify and drive business development initiatives in current /new accounts including training and education of paramedical staff. Ensure speedy and adequate availability of products in accounts.

**Financial:** Achievement of monthly secondary sales target revenue numbers (SFE)

**Non\-Financial :** Alignment to P5 plan (Segmentation and Targeting) – Deviation from MCL and account plan (WIP), SME development – As per defined list (WIP), Market Activations as per GTM (SFE)

**Behavioral:** Drive for results, Good communication skills, Data analysis and Problem solving skills, Market Orientation

**Functional:** Consultative selling, Product/Therapy knowledge, Account Planning and Management, Negotiation skills, Activation Plan

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 5\+ years of experience into sales into pharma, medical devices, medical equipment or related fields.
* B Pharma / B.Sc. / B.Tech and Masters in Management would be add on.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About The Coca\-Cola Company


At The Coca\-Cola Company, we are more than a beverage company—we are a global network of brands, people, and opportunities. We are seeking a highly organised, proactive, and trusted Executive Assistant to support senior leaders within our Integrated Operations, Commercial, and Customer Development functions.


This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, anticipates needs before they arise, exercises exceptional judgment, and operates with the highest levels of discretion and professionalism. As a key partner to leadership, you will play a critical role in enabling organisational effectiveness, managing complex priorities, and ensuring seamless execution of day\-to\-day operations.

**What You'll Do**

**Executive \& Calendar Management**

* Manage complex and dynamic executive calendars, ensuring optimal prioritization of meetings, business commitments, and strategic engagements.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve competing priorities while maximizing leader effectiveness.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings across multiple time zones and stakeholders.

**Travel \& Logistics Coordination**

* Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, visas, ground transportation, and itineraries.
* Ensure all travel arrangements are compliant with company policies and budget guidelines.
* Anticipate travel\-related challenges and proactively implement solutions to ensure seamless experiences.

**Meeting \& Event Management**

* Plan and coordinate leadership meetings, town halls, off\-sites, customer engagements, and team events.
* Manage meeting logistics, agenda coordination, room bookings, catering, and hospitality requirements.
* Support preparation of presentations, reports, briefing materials, and follow\-up actions.

**Stakeholder \& Office Coordination**

* Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, fostering strong relationships across the organization.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across functions and leadership teams.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Support expense management, purchase requisitions, invoice processing, and other administrative activities.
* Maintain organized records, documents, and departmental files.
* Identify opportunities to streamline administrative processes and improve efficiency through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide project coordination support for key business priorities and leadership initiatives.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting senior executives in a multinational, corporate, or fast\-paced business environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Proven track record of handling highly confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
* Strong project coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Microsoft Teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisational, planning, and problem\-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and adapt to changing business priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting senior leaders within Sales, Commercial, Marketing, Operations, or Corporate functions.
* Experience working in a global matrix organisation.
* Exposure to process improvement, event management, and cross\-functional coordination.

**What We Offer**


Growth \& Development


Work alongside experienced leaders and gain exposure to strategic business priorities across one of the world's most recognised organisations.

**Meaningful Impact**


Become a trusted partner to senior leadership and play a critical role in enabling business success.

**Total Rewards**


Access competitive compensation, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, and programs that support your financial and personal well\-being.

**Inclusive Culture**


Join a company that values collaboration, innovation, diversity, and continuous learning.


At The Coca\-Cola Company, every role has the potential to create impact. If you are passionate about enabling leaders, driving operational excellence, and delivering exceptional support, we would love to hear from you.

title: MANAGER- PRE SALES& LEAD CONVERSION
description:
Position: MANAGER – PRE\-SALES \& LEAD CONVERSION

Department: Sales \& Pre\-Sales

Location: Gurugram

Reporting To: Business Head / Director – Sales

Experience: 4–8 years in Real Estate Pre\-Sales, Tele\-Sales, Lead Conversion or Customer Acquisition

Industry Preference: Residential Real Estate / Luxury Real Estate / Plotted Developments / Premium Housing

Salary: 6 Lakh\-9Lakh/Year

⸻

1\. ROLE PURPOSE

The Manager – Pre\-Sales \& Lead Conversion will be responsible for managing the complete pre\-sales process from the time a lead is received until it is successfully converted into a qualified prospect and site visit.

The role requires strong communication, sales follow\-up, lead nurturing and team\-coordination skills, with a sharp focus on lead\-to\-site\-visit conversion.

The candidate will act as the primary link between Digital Marketing, Pre\-Sales and the Sales/Closing Team.

⸻

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Lead Management

\* Receive and monitor leads generated through Meta, Google, portals, website, WhatsApp and other marketing channels.

\* Ensure all fresh leads are contacted promptly.

\* Understand the prospect’s requirement, budget, location preference, purpose of purchase and purchase timeline.

\* Categorise leads into Hot, Warm, Cold and Not Qualified.

\* Maintain accurate lead records and follow\-up status in the CRM/database.

B. Lead Calling \& Qualification

\* Personally handle important/fresh incoming leads.

\* Conduct structured telephonic conversations to understand customer requirements.

\* Explain relevant project/product information and generate customer interest.

\* Identify genuine buyers and prioritise leads based on buying intent.

\* Handle initial objections related to price, location, project, payment plans and possession timelines.

\* Qualify prospects before transferring them to the Sales Team.

C. Follow\-up \& Lead Nurturing

\* Establish a systematic follow\-up process for every qualified lead.

\* Maintain regular contact through calls and WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who are not immediately ready to visit.

\* Reactivate old, dormant and previously unresponsive leads.

\* Develop long\-term relationships with prospects until they are ready for a site visit.

\* Ensure no genuine lead is left unattended or without a defined next follow\-up date.

D. Site Visit Conversion

\* Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed site visits.

\* Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding availability and customer requirements.

\* Confirm site\-visit appointments with customers.

\* Send relevant project information, location details and appointment confirmations through WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who cancel, postpone or do not turn up.

\* Track Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Site Visit conversion.

E. Team Management

\* Supervise the Pre\-Sales / Telecalling Executive(s).

\* Allocate leads and databases appropriately.

\* Monitor daily calling and follow\-up activity.

\* Review pending follow\-ups and ensure timely action.

\* Conduct daily/weekly performance reviews with the telecalling team.

\* Train team members on calling scripts, project knowledge, objection handling and follow\-up techniques.

\* Escalate high\-value and high\-intent prospects to the Sales/Closing Team.

F. CRM \& Reporting

\* Ensure complete and accurate CRM/database updation.

\* Maintain records of calls, conversations, follow\-ups and customer requirements.

\* Prepare daily and weekly pre\-sales reports.

\* Track source\-wise lead performance.

\* Monitor lead ageing and follow\-up pending reports.

\* Provide feedback to Digital Marketing regarding lead quality and campaign performance.

⸻

3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The role will primarily be measured on quality and conversion, not merely the number of calls made.

Primary KPIs

\* Lead\-to\-Contact Ratio

\* Qualified Lead Conversion

\* Lead\-to\-Site\-Visit Conversion %

\* Number of Qualified Site Visits Generated

\* Site Visit Show\-up Ratio

\* Follow\-up Completion %

\* Lead Response Time

\* Old/Cold Lead Reactivation

\* Sales\-qualified leads handed over to Sales Team

Secondary KPIs

\* CRM accuracy and discipline

\* Daily calling productivity

\* Follow\-up ageing

\* Customer response rate

\* Team productivity

\* Lead quality feedback to Marketing

⸻

4\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Manager is expected to:

1\. Review all fresh leads received.

2\. Ensure immediate contact with new enquiries.

3\. Review pending follow\-ups.

4\. Personally handle high\-value/high\-intent prospects.

5\. Monitor the telecalling executive’s activity.

6\. Qualify prospects and schedule site visits.

7\. Coordinate confirmed visits with the Sales Team.

8\. Review cancelled/no\-show visits and initiate re\-follow\-up.

9\. Update CRM and ensure every active lead has a clear next action.

10\. Submit an end\-of\-day performance report.

⸻

5\. REQUIRED SKILLS

\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

\* Strong telephonic sales and follow\-up ability.

\* Good understanding of real estate sales cycles.

\* Ability to identify genuine buying intent.

\* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.

\* Excellent follow\-up discipline.

\* Customer relationship management skills.

\* Ability to work with CRM and lead\-management systems.

\* Strong ownership of targets and results.

\* Ability to manage and motivate a small pre\-sales team.

\* Professional and presentable personality.

⸻

6\. CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate should be:

\* Experienced in real estate pre\-sales / inside sales / tele\-sales.

\* Comfortable handling high\-value residential property enquiries.

\* Target\-oriented and persistent without being overly aggressive.

\* Strong at converting conversations into appointments and site visits.

\* Comfortable working with digital leads from Google and Meta campaigns.

\* Capable of managing both fresh and old databases.

\* Data\-driven and disciplined in CRM usage.

Experience with premium/luxury residential projects, plotted developments, floors, villas or NRI clientele will be an advantage.

⸻

7\. AUTHORITY \& OWNERSHIP

The Manager will have ownership of the pre\-sales funnel from lead receipt until site\-visit generation.

The position is expected to work closely with:

Digital Marketing → Pre\-Sales → Sales → Site Team → Closing

The Manager will also provide regular feedback to Management regarding:

\* Lead quality

\* Campaign performance

\* Customer objections

\* Market response

\* Pricing feedback

\* Competitor activity

\* Reasons for lead drop\-offs

⸻

8\. SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

The Manager will be considered successful when the organisation consistently achieves:

MORE QUALITY LEADS → FASTER RESPONSE → BETTER QUALIFICATION → STRONGER FOLLOW\-UP → MORE SITE VISITS → MORE SALES

The core objective is simple:

“Every genuine enquiry must be systematically followed up and converted into a qualified sales opportunity and, wherever possible, a site visit.”

Apply Now: Send your CV/Resume to us.:

9667542182

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – SENIOR SALES EXECUTIVE

**Company:** Right Gold Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Sales  
**Designation:** Senior Sales Executive  
**Reports To:** Floor Manager / Store Manager  
**Location:** Rohini Sec\-8

**1\. Job Purpose**

The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for driving jewellery sales, managing premium customer interactions, achieving individual sales targets, ensuring excellent customer service, and supporting the Sales Team in maintaining showroom standards and business performance.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales Achievement**

* Convert walk\-in customers into successful sales.
* Generate repeat business and referrals from existing customers.
* Promote new collections, offers and special jewellery ranges.
* Upsell and cross\-sell jewellery based on customer requirements.
* Maintain strong product and market knowledge.

**B. Customer Handling**

* Welcome and attend customers professionally.
* Understand customer requirements, preferences and budget.
* Suggest suitable jewellery designs according to occasion, style and budget.
* Explain product details, weight, purity, making charges and pricing accurately.
* Handle high\-value and premium customers with proper attention.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers.
* Handle customer queries and complaints professionally.

**C. Jewellery Product Knowledge**

* Maintain complete knowledge of gold, diamond and other jewellery collections.
* Understand jewellery purity, hallmarking, diamond basics, certification and product specifications.
* Keep updated about new designs, collections and market trends.
* Ensure correct product information is communicated to customers.

**D. Sales Process \& Documentation**

* Follow the company's complete sales process and SOPs.
* Ensure accurate customer details and sales documentation.
* Coordinate with billing, accounts and purchase teams whenever required.
* Ensure proper handover of selected jewellery for billing.
* Never make unauthorized commitments regarding price, discount, exchange or delivery.

**E. Customer Follow\-Up**

* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospective customers.
* Follow up on quotations, pending decisions and product enquiries.
* Maintain customer databases and follow\-up records.
* Contact existing customers for new collections, occasions and repeat purchases.
* Generate leads through customer references and personal networking.

**F. Team Support \& Coordination**

* Support Junior Sales Executives in customer handling and sales conversion.
* Guide team members regarding product presentation and customer service.
* Share product knowledge and sales techniques with junior team members.
* Coordinate with the Senior Sales Officer / Store Manager regarding daily sales activities.
* Report operational issues, customer concerns and stock\-related issues immediately.

**G. Showroom Discipline \& Product Safety**

* Maintain proper grooming, uniform and professional appearance.
* Follow jewellery handling and security procedures strictly.
* Ensure jewellery is handled carefully and returned to its designated place after customer viewing.
* Maintain showroom cleanliness, display standards and customer area discipline.
* Follow all CCTV, security and stock\-handling procedures.

**3\. Daily Responsibilities**

* Attend customers promptly and professionally.
* Check daily sales targets and pending follow\-ups.
* Conduct customer follow\-ups.
* Update sales/follow\-up records.
* Maintain product knowledge.
* Ensure proper product presentation.
* Coordinate with team members for smooth customer handling.
* Report daily sales performance to the reporting manager.

**4\. Performance Indicators / KPIs**

* Achievement of monthly sales targets.
* Sales conversion rate.
* Average bill value.
* Number of successful customer conversions.
* Repeat customer sales.
* Lead and follow\-up conversion.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Product knowledge and sales presentation.
* Discipline and adherence to SOPs.
* Team support and coordination.

**5\. Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong jewellery sales and negotiation skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Target\-oriented approach.
* Good presentation and convincing ability.
* Strong product knowledge.
* Ability to handle premium/high\-value customers.
* Team coordination and leadership skills.
* Professional attitude and grooming.

**6\. Experience \& Qualification**

* **Qualification:** Graduate preferred.
* **Experience:** 2–5 years of relevant experience in jewellery retail sales preferred.
* Experience in gold/diamond jewellery showroom will be an advantage.
* Candidates should have strong customer\-handling and sales\-conversion skills.

**7\. Professional Standards**

* Maintain punctuality and discipline.
* Follow assigned duty timings strictly.
* Maintain proper uniform, hygiene and grooming.
* Hair should be neatly tied in a bun; makeup should be minimal and professional.
* Wear minimal jewellery while on duty.
* Maintain respectful behaviour with customers, colleagues and seniors.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer and company information.
* Follow all company policies, SOPs and instructions from management.
* Any misconduct, misbehaviour, negligence or violation of company policies may lead to disciplinary action.

title: Business Development
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Manager – Strategic Partnerships \& Business Development

Organisation: Mind Meadow

Department: Business Development \& Strategic Partnerships

Location: Delhi

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 5–8 years

Reporting To: Senior Management / Director

About Mind Meadow

Mind Meadow is a multidisciplinary child\-development and mental\-health organisation providing screening, assessments, therapy and intervention services through a structured, multidisciplinary model.

As we expand our presence across Kashmir and develop partnerships with schools, healthcare professionals, institutions and other stakeholders, we are looking for a commercially driven Manager – Strategic Partnerships \& Business Development to lead our business\-development initiatives.

Role Purpose

The role will be responsible for building and converting institutional partnerships, referral networks and strategic business opportunities that contribute to the growth of Mind Meadow.

The ideal candidate should be confident in dealing with school management, doctors, hospitals, healthcare professionals, institutions, corporates and senior decision\-makers and should be capable of taking a relationship from initial introduction through to a formal partnership.

This is a target\-driven, field\-oriented role, not an administrative position.

Key Responsibilities

1\. School \& Educational Partnerships

\* Identify schools and educational institutions with potential for collaboration.

\* Develop relationships with school owners, management, principals and administrators.

\* Present Mind Meadow’s services and partnership models.

\* Generate opportunities for:

\* Screening programmes

\* Assessments

\* Therapy services

\* Special education support

\* Teacher/parent awareness programmes

\* School\-based intervention programmes

\* Prepare and follow up on proposals, commercial discussions and MoUs.

\* Build long\-term institutional relationships.

2\. Healthcare \& Referral Network Development

Develop a structured professional referral network with:

\* Paediatricians

\* Child psychiatrists

\* Psychiatrists

\* Neurologists

\* Psychologists

\* Hospitals

\* Clinics

\* Allied healthcare professionals

\* Other relevant specialists

The objective is to establish ethical, sustainable referral relationships that increase awareness and access to Mind Meadow’s services.

3\. Strategic Partnerships

Identify and develop partnerships with:

\* Hospitals and healthcare groups

\* Educational organisations

\* Corporates

\* CSR foundations

\* NGOs

\* Community organisations

\* Government/institutional stakeholders

\* Other organisations aligned with Mind Meadow’s objectives

4\. Business Development \& Lead Generation

\* Conduct market mapping and competitor analysis.

\* Build and maintain a qualified institutional prospect database.

\* Generate new leads through networking, field visits, professional relationships and targeted outreach.

\* Conduct meetings and presentations with decision\-makers.

\* Convert qualified leads into partnerships.

\* Maintain a healthy sales/business\-development pipeline.

5\. Expansion Support

Work closely with senior management during the launch and expansion of Mind Meadow centres.

Responsibilities may include:

\* Mapping the local referral ecosystem.

\* Identifying high\-potential schools and institutions.

\* Building awareness before centre launch.

\* Developing local professional networks.

\* Supporting launch campaigns.

\* Creating a sustainable pipeline of referrals and institutional partnerships.

6\. Relationship Management

\* Maintain regular contact with existing partners.

\* Identify opportunities to expand existing collaborations.

\* Conduct periodic partner reviews.

\* Ensure commitments made during business development are properly handed over to operations.

\* Maintain accurate records of all institutional relationships.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes, not merely the number of meetings conducted.

Primary KPIs

\* Number of qualified institutional leads generated

\* Number of decision\-maker meetings

\* Number of proposals submitted

\* Number of partnerships/MoUs successfully closed

\* Revenue generated through institutional partnerships

\* Referral\-network growth

\* New school/clinic/hospital partnerships

\* Conversion rate from qualified lead → partnership

\* Business generated from existing partnerships

\* Expansion pipeline created for new centres

90\-Day Expectations

First 30 days

\* Understand Mind Meadow’s services and partnership models.

\* Complete market mapping.

\* Build a qualified prospect database.

\* Establish initial institutional contacts.

Days 31–60

\* Conduct regular institutional meetings.

\* Develop proposals.

\* Establish referral relationships.

\* Build a measurable partnership pipeline.

Days 61–90

\* Close initial partnerships.

\* Generate measurable referral/business opportunities.

\* Present a 6–12 month strategic BD plan.

Candidate Profile

Essential

\* 5–8 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, institutional sales or B2B relationship management.

\* Strong communication and presentation skills.

\* Proven ability to independently generate and convert business opportunities.

\* Comfortable meeting senior decision\-makers.

\* Strong negotiation and relationship\-management skills.

\* Willingness to travel locally for meetings and institutional visits.

\* Good understanding of CRM/reporting processes.

\* Strong commercial orientation and accountability for targets.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

\* Healthcare

\* Hospitals/clinics

\* Education

\* Child\-development services

\* Mental health

\* Diagnostics

\* Allied healthcare

\* Healthcare technology

\* Education technology

\* Institutional/B2B sales

Experience in both healthcare and education would be particularly valuable.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

\* Highly proactive

\* Result\-oriented

\* Professionally presentable

\* Excellent at networking

\* Persuasive without being aggressive

\* Comfortable with rejection and follow\-up

\* Strong at negotiation

\* Commercially aware

\* Well organised

\* Able to work independently

\* Comfortable representing the organisation at senior\-level meetings

The candidate should be a relationship builder and closer, not simply a lead generator.

Reporting \& Accountability

The Manager will report directly to Senior Management/Director and will be responsible for maintaining:

\* Weekly BD activity reports

\* Institutional pipeline

\* Lead\-conversion report

\* Partnership status tracker

\* Revenue/ business\-generation report

\* Monthly KPI review

All institutional commitments and commercial arrangements must follow Mind Meadow’s approved policies, pricing, branding and partnership framework.

What Success Looks Like

Within 6–12 months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:

A strong institutional pipeline → meaningful partnerships → increased referrals → measurable revenue/business growth → sustainable expansion opportunities for Mind Meadow.

Suggested designation for the recruitment advertisement

Manager – Strategic Partnerships \& Business Development

Healthcare \| Education \| Child Development \| Institutional Partnerships

This is a senior business\-development role for someone who can build relationships, open doors and convert opportunities into long\-term institutional partnerships.

title: Marketplace Operations Executive
description:
**Marketplace Operations Executive – Amazon \| Flipkart \| Myntra \| Blinkit**

**Experience**

2–5 years of hands\-on experience managing marketplace/e\-commerce seller accounts. Candidates with experience across multiple categories and marketplaces will be preferred.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Marketplace Operations professional who can independently manage day\-to\-day operations across Flipkart Seller Central, Amazon Seller Central, Myntra, and Blinkit.

The candidate will be responsible for pricing and margin management, inventory planning, FBF/FBA and warehouse inventory management, listing health, FSN/ASIN management, shipment planning, MRP changes, returns, account health, marketplace coordination and overall marketplace performance.

The ideal candidate should be highly analytical, commercially aware and capable of managing a large number of SKUs across multiple product categories.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Pricing \& Margin Management**

* Manage and regularly review product pricing across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Blinkit.
* Prepare SKU\-level price workings considering brand margin, marketplace commission, logistics, fulfilment charges, returns, discounts and other applicable costs.
* Ensure selling prices maintain the required profitability while remaining competitive.
* Monitor marketplace offers, promotions, discounts and price changes.
* Identify SKUs with low/negative margins and recommend corrective actions.
* Coordinate with brands/sales/finance teams for pricing approvals wherever required.

**2\. Inventory Planning \& Replenishment**

* Monitor inventory across: Company warehouse, Amazon FBA, Flipkart FBF, Blinkit and Other marketplace locations, wherever applicable.
* Analyse sales velocity, stock cover, ageing and demand to plan replenishment.
* Ensure adequate inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Identify slow\-moving and ageing inventory and develop liquidation plans.
* Coordinate with warehouse and internal teams for timely stock movement.

**3\. Flipkart Seller Central Management**

* Independently manage day\-to\-day Flipkart Seller Central operations.
* Plan and create FBF shipments based on sales velocity and inventory requirements.
* Ensure maximum feasible inventory availability under FBF while considering return rates and return losses.
* Review Flipkart listings daily for inactive, blocked, suppressed or incorrectly mapped products.
* Monitor FSN mapping, pricing, MRP, inventory and listing status.
* Handle Flipkart support cases and coordinate with category/account managers.
* Monitor seller performance, cancellations, returns and other account\-health parameters.

**4\. Amazon Seller Central Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day operations on Amazon Seller Central.
* Monitor and manage FBA and seller\-fulfilled inventory.
* Plan FBA replenishment and shipment creation based on sales velocity and stock requirements.
* Monitor ASIN\-level inventory, sales, pricing and listing status.
* Review suppressed, inactive, stranded or blocked listings and coordinate for resolution.
* Manage product pricing, promotions and offer\-related activities.
* Monitor account health, order performance, returns, cancellations and other Amazon performance metrics.
* Coordinate with Amazon Seller Support for listing, inventory, cataloguing and operational issues.
* Track FBA inventory ageing and take corrective action for slow\-moving products.

**5\. Myntra Marketplace Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day marketplace operations on Myntra.
* Monitor product listings, catalogue status, inventory and pricing.
* Coordinate inventory planning and replenishment based on sales performance.
* Monitor order processing, cancellations, returns and inventory availability.
* Coordinate with Myntra teams for catalogue, listing, pricing and operational issues.
* Monitor VMS/warehouse/packaging requirements wherever applicable.
* Ensure marketplace policies and operational requirements are followed.
* Track SKU\-level performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and inventory rotation.

**6\. Blinkit / Quick Commerce Operations**

* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities related to Blinkit and other quick\-commerce platforms, wherever applicable.
* Monitor SKU availability across stores/dark stores/fulfilment locations.
* Track inventory, sales velocity and stock\-outs.
* Coordinate replenishment and inventory movement based on demand.
* Monitor product listings, pricing, MRP and catalogue information.
* Track ageing and slow\-moving inventory and recommend liquidation strategies.
* Coordinate with Blinkit/category teams for listing, inventory, pricing and operational issues.
* Analyse store\-level/SKU\-level availability and identify gaps affecting sales.

**7\. MRP Change \& FSN/ASIN Mapping**

* Closely monitor MRP changes received from brands.
* Identify existing inventory carrying the old MRP across warehouse and marketplaces.
* Develop an appropriate marketplace mapping strategy for old and new MRP inventory.
* Plan FSN/ASIN/listing mapping to support liquidation of old\-MRP inventory.
* Ensure old\-MRP inventory is sold through before the complete transition to new\-MRP inventory wherever commercially and operationally feasible.
* Coordinate with warehouse and marketplace teams to avoid inventory blockage or losses due to MRP changes.

**8\. Listing \& Catalogue Management**

* Conduct a daily review of marketplace listings.
* Identify inactive, suppressed, blocked, unavailable or incorrectly mapped listings.
* Monitor: Product title, Images, Product attributes, MRP, Selling price, GST/tax information, Category, Brand, FSN/ASIN/SKU mapping and Inventory availability.
* Coordinate with catalogue/content teams and marketplaces for corrections.
* Ensure new products are listed and made live within the required timeline.

**9\. Returns \& Loss Management**

* Monitor return rates across marketplaces.
* Identify SKUs/categories with unusually high returns.
* Analyse the reason for returns and their financial impact.
* Track return\-related losses, damages and inventory discrepancies.
* Work with internal teams to reduce avoidable returns and improve profitability.

**10\. Sales \& Business Analysis**

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly marketplace performance reports.
* Analyse:Sales, Units sold, Inventory, Stock cover, Pricing, Margin, Returns, Cancellation, Sell\-through, Ageing inventory and Marketplace\-wise performance.
* Identify underperforming and high\-performing SKUs.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve sales and profitability.

**11\. Marketplace Support \& Issue Resolution**

* Raise and manage support cases across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Blinkit.
* Follow up proactively until issues are resolved.
* Maintain a tracker of open marketplace issues.
* Coordinate with marketplace account managers/category managers wherever required.
* Escalate critical issues affecting sales, inventory or revenue.

**12\. Marketplace Policy \& Compliance**

* Stay updated with marketplace policies and operational changes.
* Ensure listings, pricing, packaging, inventory and fulfilment processes comply with marketplace requirements.
* Identify potential compliance risks and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Central.
* Working knowledge of Myntra and Blinkit/Quick Commerce operations.
* Strong understanding of FBA, FBF and marketplace inventory processes.
* Good knowledge of FSN, ASIN, SKU, catalogue and listing management.
* Strong understanding of pricing and margin calculations.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, Data analysis and Marketplace reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple categories and a large number of SKUs.
* Strong coordination skills with warehouse, finance, sales, brand and marketplace teams.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of marketplace operations.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* 2–5 years of experience in e\-commerce/marketplace operations.
* Experience handling multiple brands/categories is preferred.
* Experience managing Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts independently.
* Exposure to Myntra and Blinkit/quick\-commerce operations.
* Experience with FBA/FBF inventory planning and shipment creation.
* Experience in pricing and profitability/margin calculations.
* Experience managing MRP changes and old\-MRP inventory liquidation.
* Strong commercial understanding with a focus on sales, inventory and profitability.
* Proactive approach toward identifying marketplace issues and opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Marketplace sales growth
* FBF/FBA inventory availability
* Reduction in stock\-outs
* Pricing and margin accuracy
* Listing health and availability
* Inventory ageing and liquidation
* MRP\-change inventory management
* Reduction in return\-related losses
* Inventory planning accuracy
* Timely marketplace issue resolution
* Marketplace account health
* Overall profitability and operational efficiency

**Role Objective**

The objective of this role is to ensure that all marketplace accounts are operationally healthy, adequately stocked, competitively priced and profitable, while proactively managing listings, inventory, fulfilment, returns, MRP changes and marketplace issues across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Blinkit.

description:

title: Sales Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Sales Manager \#\#\#


**What we believe in**



At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also use your skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.



The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite



As a Sales Engineer, you will manage the post\-sales performance of ELSP \& ELSB Products in Faridabad (NCR), India, specifying and implementing effective Panel Builder channel initiatives in line with global strategy.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Territory \& Business Development: Manage coverage of Panel Builders, Key Industries, Building, Utility End Users, and influencers; identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to reach regional sales targets.
* Sales Pipeline \& Market Intelligence: Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline, provide accurate sales forecasts, and share relevant market intelligence and customer insights with the Sales and Marketing teams.
* Customer \& Channel Management: Develop good, long\-term relationships with Panel Builders and Channel Partners by understanding customer needs, resolving issues, ensuring a positive customer experience, and acting as a trusted technical partner.
* Partner Expansion \& Business Growth: Expand the expansion of IEC 61439\-compliant partners in the assigned territory, promote new products and digitalization solutions across ELSP \& ELSB, and conduct product promotion events and technical seminars.
* Order Fulfillment \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate material delivery and after\-sales service for Panel Builders, ensure effective information flow across sales activities, and collaborate with internal teams to deliver seamless customer support and business results.


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Sales Experience: 5–10 years of relevant experience in Sales, with solid exposure to the LV Switchgear market in the NCR region.
* Product Knowledge: Solid knowledge and practical experience in Low Voltage Equipment, LV Switchgear, and Electrical Distribution solutions.
* Industrial Segment Knowledge: Good understanding of the Industrial customer segment, market dynamics, customer requirements, and electrical distribution applications.
* Direct Sales \& Business Development: Demonstrated experience in direct sales, account management, business development, and cross\-selling to meet sales and revenue targets.
* CRM \& Sales Operations: Working knowledge of SFDC/CRM operations, including opportunity management, sales pipeline tracking, forecasting, and maintaining customer information.
* Customer \& Communication Skills: Solid written, verbal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a customer\-centered mindset and an initiative\-driven approach.
* Educational Qualification: BE/B.Tech or higher qualification in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from a full\-time, regular program, with relevant industry experience.


**More about us**



ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end\-to\-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**The Position**
----------------



India is one of the fastest\-growing and most strategically important cybersecurity markets globally, and a critical pillar of OPSWAT's growth strategy.



We are looking for a Regional Sales Director, India West/Enterprise to lead and accelerate OPSWAT's sales organization and market growth in India.



This is a sales leadership opportunity for an experienced, hands\-on cybersecurity sales leader who can build and run a lean, high\-performing sales team, develop strategic customer and partner relationships, and drive significant revenue growth across private sector enterprise markets.



The role will involve working closely with the VP of APJ Sales, global leadership, and cross\-functional teams.


**Team \& Reporting**
---------------------


* Leads a growing sales team of approx. 3\-4 people Regional Sales Managers/Account Executives working closely with Solution Engineer, and Channel/Partner functions.
* Reports to the VP of APJ Sales.
* Based in Mumbai, India, with regular travel across India.

**What You Will Be Doing**
--------------------------


* Develop and execute the India West/Enterprise GTM and sales strategy to achieve revenue targets.
* Personally engage in and help close strategic, high\-value opportunities alongside the team.
* Drive growth across private sector enterprise customers including BFSI, Telecom, Manufacturing and other critical infrastructure sectors.
* Build strategic relationships with key customers and executive stakeholders.
* Identify new market opportunities and expand OPSWAT's presence across India.
* Recruit, coach, and develop a small, high\-performing sales team.
* Establish a strong sales operating cadence and partner with HR and global leadership to build and retain top talent.
* Build strategic relationships with distributors, system integrators, MSSPs, and technology partners.
* Represent OPSWAT at key industry and events and serve as executive sponsor for strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (marketing, product, customer success) to drive business growth.
* Personally lead the conglomerates strategy and execution, owning the associated quota personally.

**What We Need From You**
-------------------------


* 20\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IT, networking, or related technology sales, including direct, hands\-on selling.
* Proven experience leading small, high\-performing sales teams in India.
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets and driving multimillion\-dollar business growth.
* Strong experience selling to enterprise customers, with exposure to public sector opportunities considered an advantage.
* Established relationships across private sector enterprise customers including BFSI, Telecom, Manufacturing and other critical infrastructure sectors.
* Strong executive presence, commercial acumen and strategic thinking, balanced with a willingness to stay close to deals.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and leadership skills.
* Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a global organization.
* Strong understanding of the Indian cybersecurity market.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

title: CRM & Communications Executive
description:
**About the Role**  
SUNROOOF talks to thousands of leads and customers every month across WhatsApp, email, and SMS. This role owns that communication end\-to\-end — from the moment a lead is created to the moment they convert (or need to be nurtured until they're ready). You'll make sure the right message reaches the right person at the right stage of their journey, and that every touchpoint sounds like SUNROOOF. You'll work closely with sales, marketing, and the CRM (Zoho) to turn scattered outreach into a structured, trackable system.

**What You'll Own**

Communication across the full lead journey:

* Lead creation — instant acknowledgement across WhatsApp/email/SMS the moment a lead enters the CRM.
* First call — pre\-call context messages and post\-call follow\-ups.
* RNR (Ring No Response) — automated and manual re\-attempt sequences until the lead is reached.
* Call back later — scheduled reminder flows so no lead falls through the cracks.
* Drawings requested — status updates and nudges through design/drawing turnaround.
* Every other stage in the funnel where a lead needs a nudge, a reminder, or a follow\-up.

**Lead nurturing through automated drip campaigns**

* This is the biggest part of the role: design, build, and continuously improve multi\-step drip campaigns that keep cold and undecided leads warm over weeks and months.
* Map out drip logic by lead stage, lead source, and behavior (opened but didn't reply, visited showroom but didn't buy, asked for drawings but went quiet, etc.).
* Write and sequence the messages for each drip — timing, channel mix, and escalation points,
* Monitor drip performance and kill or rework sequences that aren't converting.

**CRM \& operations**

* Segment audiences in Zoho so messaging always matches lead stage and intent.
* Maintain message templates, approval flows, and opt\-out/compliance basics (DND, WhatsApp policy, TRAI SMS regulations).
* Coordinate with sales so automated messaging supports — not conflicts with — live conversations.
* Track open rates, response rates, and stage\-wise drop\-offs; report weekly on what's working.
* Flag broken flows, delayed responses, or channel issues before they affect leads.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong written English; can write a WhatsApp message and a formal email in equally good shape.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (formulas, filtering, and reading large lead lists).
* Process\-minded — thinks in terms of stages, triggers, and sequences, not one\-off messages.
* Prior exposure to a CRM or marketing automation tool (Zoho, WATI, Interakt, Klaviyo, or similar) is a strong plus.
* 0–2 years of experience; freshers with the right aptitude are welcome to apply.
* Comfortable working in\-office out of Sultanpur, Delhi

* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

  

  

**What Makes You Qualified?**  

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.

**Who You Are**

* Detail\-oriented and hands\-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer\-facing, fast\-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. * Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
